autori.bio: Labiba Hashim (1952-1882) was a Lebanese author who founded and published Fatat al-Sharq magazine in Cairo in 1906, one of the first female-oriented magazines of the Arab world. In the magazine Hashim advocated for women's rights, especially rights related to women's education and involvement in politics. Today, many researchers are working to collect information about Hashim in order to preserve her heritage and legacy.

autori.bio: John Maynard Keynes, 1º barone Keynes di Tilton, è stato un economista britannico, padre della macroeconomia.

it.testo: John Maynard Keynes, 1º barone Keynes di Tilton, è stato un economista britannico, padre della macroeconomia.

en.testo: John Maynard Keynes, 1st Baron Keynes, was an English economist. His writings formed the basis for the school of thought known as Keynesian economics, as well as its various offshoots. Originally trained in mathematics, he built on and refined earlier work on the causes of business cycles. His ideas, further developed after his death as New Keynesianism, are seen as foundational to mainstream macroeconomics.
